script_text: Brace yourself, Aquarius — this week brings a cosmic shift that will shake your foundations. Monday through Wednesday, Mercury conjunct Saturn in your 10th House creates heavy communication challenges at work — avoid signing contracts until clarity arrives. The square between Mars and Uranus on Tuesday sparks tension in your Air career sector, so tread carefully. The turning point arrives Wednesday evening when Venus enters your 7th House of partnerships, softening the week's harsh edges. Thursday through Sunday, the Sun trine Neptune in your 12th House brings intuitive clarity and spiritual renewal. Weekend energy favors deep emotional connections — your love life awakens Saturday under this harmonious aspect. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 7th House, while Monday remains your worst day due to Mercury-Saturn conjunction blocking progress. Trust your intuition — Uranus amplifies your inner guidance this week. Follow for daily updates.
